boardSubtitle: Seed a person (query and/or documents); an identity hub harvests, and self-muting lenses present each channel

meta.title: Who are we investigating?
meta.desc: Describe the person and why you are investigating them — a name, plus any context (role, company, city) that helps pin the right individual. This sets the frame for the whole board; edit it any time to re-point the investigation.

data.value: Name the person to investigate and why — for example: _Alex Rivera, senior backend engineer, applying for a staff role; verify background and public footprint._ Add any city, employer, or handle you already know.

meta.title: Documents & Evidence
meta.desc: Drop a resume, dossier, or any supporting document here — or write a note, or both. The identity hub reads whatever you provide before searching the open web.

data.value: Attach documents, write a message, or both. The identity hub reads these first.

meta.title: Identity Hub
meta.desc: Reads the uploaded documents and the query, then searches the web to disambiguate the person and harvest their public footprint in a single pass. Publishes the candidates and the subject profile every lens builds on.

compute.expr:
($id := fetched_sources.harvest.subject_profile.identity; $exists($id) ? ("### " & ($id.name ? $id.name : "Unknown subject") & "

**Profession:** " & ($id.profession ? $id.profession : "—") & "  
**Confidence:** " & ($exists($id.confidence) ? $string($id.confidence) : "—") & "

" & ($id.summary ? $id.summary : "")) : "_Harvesting identity… add a name or purpose above, or upload a document, and this hub will disambiguate and gather the public footprint._")

meta.title: Identity Disambiguation
meta.desc: The people who plausibly match this name. When more than one matches, confirm which one the investigation is about; with a single confident match, no decision is needed.

compute.expr: ($count(requires.candidates) > 1) ? { "kind": "table" } : { "kind": "markdown", "data": { "value": ($count(requires.candidates) = 1 ? ("_Single confident match: " & requires.candidates[0].name & ". No disambiguation needed._") : "_Awaiting identity harvest\u2026_") } }

meta.title: Professional Background
meta.desc: Career history from the subject profile. Presents roles when present; mutes itself when the subject has no professional record on file.

compute.expr: ($count(requires.subject_profile.linkedin.roles) > 0) ? { "kind": "table" } : { "kind": "markdown", "data": { "value": "_No professional background found for this subject yet._" } }

meta.title: News & Press
meta.desc: Recent press and public mentions. Presents items when present; mutes itself when there is no coverage.

compute.expr: ($count(requires.subject_profile.news.items) > 0) ? { "kind": "table" } : { "kind": "markdown", "data": { "value": "_No recent news or press mentions found._" } }

meta.title: Social Presence
meta.desc: Public social and professional handles. Presents handles when present; mutes itself when the subject has no public social footprint.
